name: TikTok Shop breakout finder
why: Scores products from TikTok Shop research graphs before you test them, so hero picks start from early breakouts, not crowded products.

name: Price a product so it pays after every cost
why: Works out true margin and the discount depth that keeps profit, the same sum behind every hero pick.

name: Product margin checker
why: Quick margin check per product when you only need one row of the margin table.

name: Winning product scorer
why: Scores a new product idea and its costs before it joins the shop.

name: Live auction show planner
why: A run order, promotion schedule and profit sheet for live selling shows, useful alongside the LIVE run sheet skill.

name: Short video hook writer
why: Ten hooks per product checked for length and first shot, for the shoppable video briefs.

name: Short video format picker
why: Picks a format and script outline for who is on camera, to turn one good video into a repeatable format.

name: Organic format tester
why: Reads 20 posts and their numbers to find the formats that sell, for the weekly review.

name: Creator ad roster builder
why: A gifting funnel, roster size, pay rule and creator brief, to set the sample rule and budget.

name: Creator pay planner
why: Checks whether a flat fee or a floor-or-commission offer to a creator makes sense before you ask the client for a yes.

name: Bundle and quantity-break builder
why: Builds bundle tiers that hold margin, for LIVE bundles and add-ons.

name: Returns policy designer
why: Sets refund timing and keep-it rules from returns data, when TikTok returns start to eat margin.

name: Start your store's organic social from zero
why: Setup fixes, formats and hooks to film for a store starting from nothing on social, before the first shoppable videos.
